rationale: The agent did look up the user by name and ZIP and retrieved user/order details, satisfying initial authentication. However, it executed order-changing actions (two exchanges) without any explicit user confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm before writes. The jigsaw request was also underspecified (“more fancy theme,” 500 fewer pieces, same difficulty), and the agent proceeded without clarifying or proposing options. Additionally, the product detail lookups do not align clearly with the new item ID used for the exchange, so difficulty/piece-count matching is unverified. The final message provides no confirmation details or outcome summary. Therefore, the agent did not complete the request in line with policy.
